name: goldnead/statamic-teams
description: Teams for Statamic: workspaces with members, roles per team, invitations by link and join code. A team can hold access and buy on its own billing address.

suggest.goldnead/statamic-brand-context: Makes the invitation lifetime, join-code length and the mail switches editable under Settings, Addon settings.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-email-templates: Every mail of this addon becomes a template an editor can change in the Control Panel.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-entitlements: A team becomes a subject: access granted to the team holds for every member.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-payments: A team can be the buyer, with its own billing address.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-automations: Every team event (created, member joined, invitation sent ...) becomes an automation trigger.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-webhook-manager: Every team event becomes a webhook trigger.
suggest.goldnead/statamic-activity: Team changes are written to the activity log.

statamic.name: Teams
statamic.description: Workspaces with members, roles per team and invitations.
